name: em-woo-team-manage
description: This plugin adds a team management page for WooCommerce customers to import other users and manage those users.
author: Esmond Mccain

scripts.test:integration:install: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/em-Woo-Team-Manage sh -lc "COMPOSER=composer.integration.json composer install --no-interaction --no-progress"
scripts.test:integration: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/em-Woo-Team-Manage php vendor-integration/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.integration.xml
scripts.build:sass: sass admin/assets/sass/site-admin-team-leader.scss admin/assets/css/site-admin-team-leader.css --no-source-map && sass admin/assets/sass/team-leader-admin.scss admin/assets/css/team-leader-admin.css --no-source-map && sass admin/assets/sass/team-leader-user-import.scss admin/assets/css/team-leader-user-import.css --no-source-map && sass admin/assets/sass/team-leader-myaccount.scss admin/assets/css/team-leader-myaccount.css --no-source-map
scripts.minify:adminjs: terser admin/assets/js/teamLeaderAdmin.js -o admin/assets/js/min/teamLeaderAdmin.min.js --compress --mangle --source-map && terser admin/assets/js/teamSubordinateImport.js -o admin/assets/js/min/teamSubordinateImport.min.js --compress --mangle --source-map && terser admin/assets/js/siteAdminTeamLeader.js -o admin/assets/js/min/siteAdminTeamLeader.min.js --compress --mangle --source-map
